name: carousel
purpose: 3D slide carousel — entries sit on a circle in perspective, the selected one faces front and the rest recede; click, arrow keys or the selected prop rotate the ring (used by the Keyguard for account and word choices).

props.name: entries
props.description: Slide names; each names a slot that provides that slide's content.

props.name: selected
props.description: Entry name to bring to the front. Invalid or missing values fall back to the first entry.

props.name: entryMargin
props.description: Minimum gap in px between neighboring slides; sets the ring radius together with the slide widths.

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Tween duration in ms for radius and rotation changes.

props.name: hideBackgroundEntries
props.description: display:none for entries on the back half of the circle.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and rotates all non-selected entries to the hidden back position.

notes: Sample state: 3 slides ('Card 1/2/3' as fixed 200x240 nq-cards), middle selected, entryMargin 16 (default), settled (no tween running). JS-MEASURED GEOMETRY TRAP: upstream positions every slide from JS — it measures slide offsetWidth/offsetHeight, derives radius = (maxNeighborDistance/2)/sin(pi/entryCount), tweens per-entry rotations (Tweenable from @nimiq/utils), and writes transform/z-index/min-height into element.style each animation frame. The html variant freezes those exact styles inline (values documented in truth.html); it is a static snapshot — changing selection/rotation needs the Vue variant, where the full Tweenable loop is ported (Tweenable itself is inlined verbatim, so no npm dep). Slides must have a fixed size for the frozen numbers to hold; resizing slides or margins means recomputing x=sin(r)*radius, z=cos(r)*radius-radius per entry. z-index is assigned by ascending z (stable sort), NOT transform-style:preserve-3d — upstream avoids preserve-3d because it breaks clickability. With 1 or 2 entries upstream adds a dummy circle position so the second entry is not hidden exactly behind the first. The 1500px perspective on the container projects the z=-187.06 side cards to ~89% scale. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight rotate (ignored while an input/textarea has focus, while disabled, or before the previous tween is half done).
